dublinCore.dc:title: 116 HR 8508 IH: COVID–19 Vaccine Distribution and Production Act

action.action-desc: Mr. Crist (for himself, Mr. Pocan, and Ms. Blunt Rochester) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To require the President to use authorities under the Defense Production Act of 1950 to require emergency production of the supplies necessary for distributing and administering the COVID–19 vaccine, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the COVID–19 Vaccine Distribution and Production Act.

section.header: Emergency production of the supplies necessary for equitably distributing and administering the COVID–19 vaccine

subsection.text: Not later than 1 day after the date of the enactment of this section, the President shall—

paragraph.text: determine under section 101(b) of the Defense Production Act of 1950 (50 U.S.C. 4511(b)) that—

subparagraph.text: supplies necessary for equitably distributing and administering the COVID–19 vaccine are a scarce and critical material essential to the national defense; and

the requirements of the national defense for the supplies necessary for equitably distributing and administering the COVID–19 vaccine cannot be met without exercising the authorities provided by the Defense Production Act of 1950 (50 U.S.C. 4501 et seq.);

paragraph.text: identify private sector capacity to produce the supplies necessary for equitably distributing and administering the COVID–19 vaccine; and
exercise the authorities provided by the Defense Production Act of 1950 (50 U.S.C. 4501 et seq.) to the extent necessary—

subparagraph.text: to require emergency production of the supplies necessary for equitably distributing and administering the COVID–19 vaccine; and
to establish a fair and reasonable price for the sale of the supplies produced pursuant to subparagraph (A).

subsection.text: The President shall coordinate and direct the equitable distribution of the supplies produced under subsection (a)(3)(A) based on—

paragraph.text: requests submitted to the President by the Governors of the States; and
the needs of the States, as determined based on the populations of each State.

subsection.text: Amounts available in the Defense Production Act Fund under section 304 of the Defense Production Act of 1950 (50 U.S.C. 4534) shall be available to carry out this section.

paragraph.text: This section shall terminate on the date on which there are no remaining requests under subsection (b)(1).

paragraph.header: Disposition of unused supplies necessary for equitably distributing or administering the COVID–19 vaccine
paragraph.text: Any supplies produced pursuant to subsection (a)(3)(A) using amounts from the Defense Production Act Fund and unused as of the date described in paragraph (1) shall be deposited in the Strategic National Stockpile under section 319F–2 of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 247d–6b), including any such supplies authorized for emergency use under section 564 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 360bbb–3).
The term COVID–19 vaccine means a vaccine to prevent or mitigate COVID–19 that the Food and Drug Administration licenses or authorizes for emergency use.
The term State includes the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, Guam, American Samoa, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
